title: Serve-port seam for local_resource: model.LocalTarget port field + portregistry wiring
description: Follow-up from tk-zkx validation: per-worktree local_resource serve ports cannot be deconflicted through the port registry because model.LocalTarget (pkg/model/local_target.go) carries no port field and serve ports never reach internal/portregistry (its only consumers: internal/tiltfile/docker_compose.go:651 DC port_specs, internal/controllers/core/portforward/reconciler.go:216 k8s PortForward CRs). Deliverable: add serve-port field to LocalTarget (or CmdServerSpec seam), wire worktree-flagged local_resources' serve ports through portregistry.Allocate keyed per worktree, tests: two worktrees with same serve port get distinct registry allocations; main unchanged. Parent epic tk-ygh, label worktrees. See .agents/match/validations/tk-zkx-evidence.txt for the verified gap analysis.

comments.author: yuri
comments.text: DONE: serve-port seam for local_resource (merged master b7af267ee into tk-kxc first — clean fast-forward). Changes: (1) model.LocalTarget gains ServePort field + WithServePort/WithServeCmdEnv helpers (pkg/model/local_target.go). (2) local_resource accepts serve_port= int kwarg, validated: error when serve_cmd empty (internal/tiltfile/local_resource.go). (3) translateLocal: worktree runs allocate via portregistry.Allocate(owner='lr:<worktree>/<resource>', requested) — sticky across reloads, distinct per worktree, honors port_range with OS-fallback — and inject TILT_SERVE_PORT=<port> into ServeCmd.Env so the process binds the deconflicted port; main runs keep authored port untouched (internal/tiltfile/tiltfile_state.go). Verified: go test ./pkg/model ./internal/engine/local ./internal/controllers/core/cmd ./internal/portregistry ./internal/store ./internal/hud/webview ./internal/controllers/core/portforward — all pass; ./internal/tiltfile passes except pre-existing baseline failures TestKustomizeFlags/TestKustomizeBin (kustomize binary absent from PATH, fail identically on clean master); all 41 local_resource/worktree/DC-port/worktree_config tests green incl. new TestLocalResource_WorktreeServePortDeconflict, TestLocalResource_TwoWorktreesNoServePortClash (+reload stability), TestLocalResource_WorktreeNoServePortUnchanged, TestLocalResourceServePortWithoutServeCmd, TestServePortEnvAndRestart. Commit 38ccb7643.
